Lemma
[The Pushforward Frame is a Basis]

↗ lem:orthonormal-pushforward

In the preceding situation, $(d\varphi _x(E_i|_x))$ is a basis of $T_{\varphi (x)}\widetilde M$.

Proof

↗ lem:orthonormal-pushforward \sketch It is an orthonormal, hence linearly independent, family of $n=\dim T_{\varphi (x)}\widetilde M$ vectors.

□
